places.name: IdleTankers
places.description: Tankers parked at the depot and free to be dispatched, each carrying its product, payload, and whether it is a spot hire.

places.name: LoadsDelivered
places.description: Cumulative count of tanker deliveries unloaded at a customer.

places.name: Returning
places.description: Tankers on the empty run back to the depot; the returning dynamics count their journey clock down to zero.

places.name: OpenOrders
places.description: Count of orders currently open across all customers. Hiring a tanker needs at least three; releasing a hired one needs none.

places.name: Hires
places.description: Cumulative count of spot-hired tankers.

places.name: Plant
places.description: Single token for the air separation plant that fills the tankers: up is 1 while producing and 0 during an outage. Dispatch reads it to pick the normal or re-sourced route.

places.name: Outages
places.description: Cumulative count of plant trips.

places.name: SteadyNitrogenOrderPlaced
places.description: An open order from the steady nitrogen customer, waiting for a tanker. At most one is open at a time because raising an order also takes the order permit.

places.name: SteadyNitrogenOrderPermits
places.description: The single permit that lets the steady nitrogen customer have one order open at a time. Raising an order takes it; unloading the delivery hands it back.

places.name: SteadyNitrogenOnRoute
places.description: A tanker on its way to the steady nitrogen customer. Its journey clock counts down under the on-route dynamics and the delivery unloads when it reaches zero.

places.name: SteadyNitrogenVented
places.description: Cumulative count of relief-valve openings at the tank of the steady nitrogen customer, each losing vent_loss units.

places.name: SteadyNitrogenLineRunning
places.description: Marker token present while the production line of the steady nitrogen customer is running on gas from the tank.

places.name: SteadyNitrogenLineStopped
places.description: Marker token present while the line of the steady nitrogen customer is stopped because the tank is empty.

places.name: SteadyNitrogenStockouts
places.description: Cumulative count of times the tank of the steady nitrogen customer ran dry and stopped the line.

places.name: SteadyNitrogenTank
places.description: The cryogenic tank of the steady nitrogen customer as a single token. Its level and pressure evolve continuously under the Tank dynamics; the ordering, venting, and line transitions read them and fire on threshold crossings (trigger_1 for ordering).

transitions.name: Raise an order (SteadyNitrogen)
transitions.description: Fires the moment the tank level of the steady nitrogen customer drops below trigger_1, taking the order permit and adding to OpenOrders. The tank token is read and put back unchanged.

transitions.name: Dispatch a tanker (SteadyNitrogen)
transitions.description: With the plant up, an idle tanker carrying nitrogen loads for the steady nitrogen customer at loading_rate (a mismatched tanker's rate is 1e-9) and sets off with a lognormal journey around 6 hours times route_scale, spread route_spread. Closes one open order.

transitions.name: Dispatch a re-sourced tanker (SteadyNitrogen)
transitions.description: The same dispatch for the steady nitrogen customer while the plant is down: product comes from a farther source, so the journey mean is multiplied by outage_route_penalty.

transitions.name: Unload the tanker (SteadyNitrogen)
transitions.description: When the journey clock reaches zero the tanker discharges as much of its payload as the tank of the steady nitrogen customer has room for, hands back the order permit, counts a delivery, and starts the return run.

transitions.name: Vent through the relief valve (SteadyNitrogen)
transitions.description: Pressure in the tank of the steady nitrogen customer reaching relief_setpoint lifts the valve: vent_loss units of product are lost and pressure drops to the setpoint minus relief_reseat, so the valve cycles while the tank stays nearly full.

transitions.name: Stop the line (SteadyNitrogen)
transitions.description: The line of the steady nitrogen customer stops the instant the tank level reaches zero and a stockout is counted.

transitions.name: Resume the line (SteadyNitrogen)
transitions.description: The line of the steady nitrogen customer restarts as soon as the tank level is above zero again.

transitions.name: Raise an order (SlowNitrogen)
transitions.description: Fires the moment the tank level of the slow-drawing nitrogen customer drops below trigger_2, taking the order permit and adding to OpenOrders. The tank token is read and put back unchanged.

transitions.name: Return a tanker to the depot
transitions.description: The return clock reaches zero and the tanker is idle at the depot again, keeping its product, payload, and hire status.

transitions.name: Hire a tanker
transitions.description: With three or more orders open and hire_enabled set, a spot tanker is hired at hire_rate: it carries hired_payload of nitrogen (oxygen if hire_oxygen is set) and is flagged as hired.

transitions.name: Release a hired tanker
transitions.description: An idle hired tanker leaves the fleet as soon as no orders are open.

transitions.name: Trip the air separation plant
transitions.description: The plant trips at rate 1/uptime_hours while up, counting an outage.

transitions.name: Restart the air separation plant
transitions.description: A tripped plant is back up at rate 1/repair_hours.

metrics.name: Stockouts
metrics.description: Times a customer line stopped for want of product.

metrics.name: Criticality-weighted stockouts
metrics.description: Stockouts weighted by how much the customer matters: the metals plant counts 3, the freezing plant 2, the laser shop 1. A total count cannot say whether the outages landed on the customer you could least afford to lose.

metrics.name: Vented through relief
metrics.description: Units lost through a relief valve, in units at every level. Below the continuous levels the Vented place holds one token per unit, because the tank is a pile of one-unit tokens. From the continuous levels it holds one token per valve opening, each worth vent_loss units, so the count is scaled to keep this metric comparable down the sequence. Structurally reachable everywhere, and unreachable in practice below the continuous levels: under a level trigger the tank never fills completely, and with no pressure nothing else opens the valve.

metrics.name: Evaporated
Surplus lost on delivery
metrics.description: Units a tanker could not fit into the tank. From this level the arrival kernel fills the tank to capacity and drops the remainder, where levels 1 to 3 held the delivery back until it fit. It reads 0 in every scenario here, because the reorder trigger plus the largest possible outstanding order stays at least 14 units below capacity in all three tanks (40 of 54, 18 of 30, 44 of 58), so a load always fits. The metric guards that headroom against a change in trigger, payload or permit count.

metrics.name: Consumed
Stockouts per 100 units delivered to customers
metrics.description: Stockouts against the volume actually drawn. A demand process that cannot go negative consumes more when it is more volatile, so a raw count would credit a volatile scenario for being busier as well as worse.

metrics.name: SteadyNitrogen stockouts
metrics.description: Times the food freezing plant stopped.

metrics.name: SlowNitrogen stockouts
metrics.description: Times the laser cutting shop stopped.

metrics.name: Level in tanks
metrics.description: Units left across the three customer tanks at the end.

metrics.name: Relief valve openings
metrics.description: Times a relief valve lifted. The valve reseats below the setpoint, so a tank that stays near it cycles, and the count of openings says how hard the valve is working where the units vented say what it cost.

metrics.name: Pressure at SlowNitrogen
metrics.description: Tank pressure at the slow-drawing customer, where boil-off gas has the least ullage to fill.

metrics.name: Tankers hired in
metrics.description: Trailers created on demand. A fixed-population net cannot represent this at all.

metrics.name: Plant outages
metrics.description: Times the air separation plant tripped and its customers were re-sourced onto longer routes.

title: Gases 4 — dynamic coloured net
description: Dynamic coloured net: each customer's tank is one token whose level and pressure evolve continuously, with orders, venting, and line stops fired by threshold crossings rather than by counting units. Journeys are lognormal countdowns, spare tankers can be hired when orders pile up, and an air separation plant that trips forces deliveries onto longer re-sourced routes.
